tools.name: find_token_insiders
tools.description: Find the wallets a token's creator is linked to by money (a Solana token, or a Robinhood Chain or BNB Chain one with chain), with the payments that link them and how much of the supply they bought and hold, and why none were found when none were. Costs 2 credits, or without an API key $0.10 paid per

tools.name: scan_launch_tool
tools.description: Whether a Solana wallet launched or traded memecoins with a known launch kit, with the verdict, the transactions that show it, the tokens the wallet launched and the wallets that funded it, walked up to its root funder with what Iris knows of that root. A token's mint scans its creator. Costs 5 cred

tools.name: follow_funds
tools.description: Follow the main stream of money out of one wallet, hop by hop, until it reaches an exchange (with the deposit address), a bridge, a mixer or a swap (it names the asset bought, to follow next), or comes to rest. On Solana, an EVM chain, Bitcoin or Tron. Each hop says how the money went, with its tran

tools.name: explain_transaction
tools.description: One transaction read and explained in plain words: who moved what to whom, through which programs, the swap or bridge transfer it made, its parties with their labels, and (Solana) the wallets it shows are controlled by the same owner. A Solana signature, an EVM hash, or a dYdX, Noble, Bitcoin or Tro

tools.name: get_connections
tools.description: Every counterparty of an address that analyze_address analyzed in the last hour on this account (without an API key: for the x402 payer whose receipt is given): wallets it sent to or received from and the venues it swapped on, with labels, the native coin (SOL, ETH, BTC, TRX...) and stablecoins move

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: The account's plan and what is left: analyses, traces and pack credits, when the allowance renews, and what each tool costs. Without an API key: what each tool costs per call with x402. Free.
